Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars; Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Things go wrong for Mr. Porter and Winnie Winnington at the orienteering relay in Yellowbone National Park; Mayor Goodway invites her friend Helga Humdinger and her rival Mayor Humdinger to City Hall for afternoon tea.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E02 — Pups Save Election Day; Pups Save the Bubble Monkeys
When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control; when Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys finds itself in sticky bubble trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E22 — Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News
Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Alex dreams that his Mini Patrol animals can talk; the animals take the Bookmobile on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger steals the ancient book.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Molly and Gil see how bubble-cakes are made when they step into Chef Stef's kitchen; the Guppies get their turn when they take the field to play batterbal; it'll take teamwork to run the kitchen-station bases and bake a treat!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E12 — The Sizzling Scampinis!
The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E24 — Bubble Kitty!
When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E18 — Swinging in the Rainforest!
City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E13 — The Unidentified Flying Orchestra!
After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E13 — The Kingdom of Laughs-a-Lot!
Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E10 — Dragons N' Roses!
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E19 — The Fastest Feather in the Race!
It's Team Flightless versus cocky Amelia the peregrine falcon; though Penguin Nonny, Ostrich Oona, and Kiwi Goby can't fly, these birds of a feather flock together; teamwork must be enough for them to win the race.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E09 — Sheep Doggy!
Molly and Gil meet Farmer Joe and all the cool barnyard animals on his farm; when Farmer Joe's cute baby lamb wanders off during a big swirling popcorn storm, Bubble Puppy has to become a sheepdog and herd her back to safety!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

The PAW Patrol helps an extra-terrestrial after his spaceship crash lands at Farmer Yumi's place; the Pups come to the rescue when Smiley the frog jumps into Skye's helicopter.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E11 — The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Station
Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall; when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E25 — Pups Raise the PAW Patroller; Pups Save the Crows
When Daring Danny sinks the PAW Patroller, the pups must find a way to raise their rig; the pups team up with Alex's mini patrol to retrieve mysteriously missing items.

title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
description:
S07 E26 — The Robot Championship
It's the Robot Championship, and only the fastest, strongest and smartest robot will win; using coding, Blaze tries to win enough sports to take home the trophy.

title: Santiago of the Seas
description:
S02 E18 — The Secret Room; Little Shrimp, Big Problems
After commandeering the new clubhouse for himself, Pepito traps the Pirate Protectors inside a secret room that they can only escape from if they work together as friends; the grand opening of Martin's paleta shop is almost ruined.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E12 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins
When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E26 — Pups and the Pirate Treasure
Cap'n Turbot stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout; the PAW Patrol searches for clues to find the missing pieces of a treasure map.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine; Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket.

title: DORA
description:
Captain Dora; Bruno And The Bunny Boyz
Dora takes charge as a bold captain to help the Pirate Piggies save a ship in trouble; Dora supports Bruno as preparation begins for a Bunny Boyz performance.

description:
The Missing Magical Instruments; Mr. Banana's Big Puppet Show

description:

Grandpa and Granny Pig have been growing strawberries; Peppa and family make pizzas; Peppa and her family celebrate Grandpa Pig's birthday; Daddy Pig thinks he's an expert pancake maker; Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Rubble and Wild team up to stop a giant runaway yarn ball rolling through town; Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E05 — Pups Save Their Digi-Tal Friends; Pups Save the Rainbow
The PAW Patrol must save the day when two overly helpful robots take on more than they can handle; in a dream, Mayor Humdinger finds a prism that makes rainbows and drains Adventure Bay of color; the pups must restore color to Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E18 — Pups Save Little Hairy; Pups Save a Kooky Climber
Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole, and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy; Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E03 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Sunken Sloop; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Wiggly Whale
Sid the Pirate and his first mate, Arrby, take the sunken sloop; a wiggling whale knocks the diving bell to the bottom of the ocean, with Cap'n Turbot and Francois trapped inside.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E22 — Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies; Pups Save the Greenhouse
Humdinger's hands are full when he babysits his new friend's kids; Everest helps the pups rescue both mayors trapped inside a greenhouse.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E09 — Air Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-stronaut
Captain Gordy and his space shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite! But when Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies, the space shuttle blasts off with him still inside! Air Rescue pups save him.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E18 — Pups Save an Adventure; Pups Save a Surprise
The PAW Patrol joins Alex and Mr. Porter at their campsite and teaches them how to safely build and extinguish a camp fire; while rescuing Chickaletta from the top of City Hall, the pups notice that it has been decorated for a big celebration.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E16 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Shark; Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Pier
Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone away from the beach; the pups come to the rescue when the pier has a broken support post.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
The Crew Builds a Conveyor Belt Restaurant; The Crew Makes a Community Soup
Rubble and Crew want to help open a new restaurant for everyone at the Buddy Walk Race, but they can't decide what kind of restaurant to build!; when Grandpa Gravel is feeling under the weather, Rubble and Crew step in to make his signature soup.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E17 — The Crew Celebrates BuilderCovegiving Day; The Crew Builds a Rocket Ship Ride
After Speed Meister sabotages Family, Friends and Fun Day, it's up to the pups to save the holiday for everyone in Builder Cove; Mix dreams about giving the moon a Mix makeover.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

The PAW Patrol must rescue Mayor Humdinger; Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E11 — Air Rescue: Pups vs. the Hum-Cloud; Air Rescue: Pups Stop the Mid-Air Magnet
Humdinger tries to sabotage the Air Rescue Pups' Air Show; Uncle Otis' powerful magnetic drone goes rogue and starts picking up every metal object in sight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E22 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Frozen Flounder; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Narwhal
Cap'n Turbot's boat gets frozen in the Arctic ice; the pups use the Sea Patroller to help guide a lost narwhal back home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E23 — Pups Save the Gliding Turbots; Pups Save a Plane
When Francois and Cap'n Turbot get stranded on a remote island, Ryder and the pups must fly in to rescue the bickering cousins; the pups must come to the rescue when Mayor Goodway's first flying lesson goes awry.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E05 — Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E17 — Happy Clam Day!
The Bubble Guppies have to learn about the mail so they can send invitations to a party for Clam.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E07 — Firefighter Gil to the Rescue!
Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Secret Agent Nonny is on a mission to deliver mysterious messages to all of his agent friends, which are actually invitations to his own surprise birthday party.
